mentions.name: Matricsy
mentions.description: This app lets companies create competency matrices as the basis for defining skills, evaluating people, and supporting growth. It also serves as a lightweight day-to-day team management tool for managers, including 1-on-1 notes, development goals, and overall team management. A Polish-language version is currently in development.
mentions.audience: Managers running their teams day to day
mentions.source_excerpt: App for creating a competency matrix, which is at the heart of how a company defines skills, evaluates people, and supports growth. A lightweight tool for managers to run their teams day to day, including 1 on 1 notes, development goals, and overall team management. It's called Matricsy (matricsy.com), but right now I'm working on PL version: https://matryca-kompetencji.pl/
